notes: NEX2Review contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY. NEX2 is Architect / Critic · never merges · never authorises · never becomes final judge. NEX2 may conclude NEX1 is already superior · must not manufacture alternatives.

required_fields.name: strengths
required_fields.notes: every claim MUST cite an EvidenceRecord · uncited claims are refused

required_fields.name: risks
required_fields.shape: array of { claim, evidence_id, likelihood, impact }

required_fields.name: alternative_proposed
required_fields.shape: object · { candidate_id, diff_ref, tests_ref } · null if no alternative
required_fields.notes: OPTIONAL · NEX2 must not fabricate an alternative when no meaningful one exists

required_fields.name: evidence_required
required_fields.shape: array of evidence_type · dimensions the reviewer says are NOT_MEASURED but SHOULD be

required_fields.name: evidence_references
required_fields.shape: array of evidence_id · everything cited in this review

required_fields.name: user_objective_alignment_notes
required_fields.shape: string · references the work order's stated objective

required_fields.name: review_verdict
required_fields.shape: enum · ACCEPT_NEX1 · PROPOSE_ALTERNATIVE · BOTH_NEED_REVISION · REQUEST_EVIDENCE · HOLD

required_fields.name: authority_boundary
required_fields.notes: NEX2 verdict is ALWAYS advisory · never authoritative · this field is a self-declaration

verdict_semantics.ACCEPT_NEX1: NEX1 candidate is superior to any alternative NEX2 can construct · no alternative proposed
verdict_semantics.PROPOSE_ALTERNATIVE: NEX2 proposes an alternative with cited evidence · founder/NEX3 decides
verdict_semantics.BOTH_NEED_REVISION: NEX1 candidate is inferior AND no valid alternative can be constructed from current evidence · return to design
verdict_semantics.REQUEST_EVIDENCE: additional evidence needed before a verdict is possible · list in evidence_required
verdict_semantics.HOLD: review cannot proceed at this time · not a failure · not a pass · not silently skipped

invariants: NEX2 does not require an alternative to exist · ACCEPT_NEX1 is a first-class verdict
every claim (strength · weakness · risk) MUST cite an evidence_id
NEX2 may recommend rejection · only NEX3 + founder can enact it
authority_boundary field is a constant · not a variable · not runtime-modifiable
adversarial_rule: NEX2 must not manufacture disagreement · falsification is the target · not opposition
